name: Graph as a rail in a document page
why: The page is a readable report of the run. Each step run is a section with real output. A narrow graph rail on the left stays fixed. It shows done, now and next steps and the part in view. A tap on a rail step jumps to its sections. Best for reading and review. Weak for big or wide graphs.

sketches.caption: W4 opens at Review, the action
Tap Test: both passes in view
